settings.load_invalid: Saved settings are invalid; defaults are active. User bookmarks, tabs, and protected-folder rules from that file were not loaded. Back up the file before saving new preferences.
settings.load_failed: Could not read saved settings; defaults are active. User bookmarks, tabs, and protected-folder rules from that file were not loaded.
settings.save_failed: Could not save settings. Check write access to the settings folder.
settings.reset_confirm_scope: Behavior preferences such as language, appearance, file display, navigation, deletion mode, updates and performance will return to defaults. Your bookmarks, open and pinned tabs, active tab, and protected-folder list will be kept. Files, Windows Recycle Bin contents, protected-trash contents and system bookmarks will not be changed.
settings.reset_confirm_load_issue: Behavior preferences will return to defaults. At startup, the saved settings file could not be loaded, so its bookmarks, tabs and protected-folder list were not recovered. Only data currently in memory (which may be empty) can be kept. If saving succeeds, the current file will be replaced; this cannot recover unavailable data. Files, recycle-bin contents and system bookmarks are not changed.
settings.reset_done: Behavior settings were reset; your user data was kept.
settings.reset_done_restart: Behavior settings were saved. Restart FileManager to apply the single-instance change.
settings.reset_session_only: Reset was applied only in this session and was not saved. The existing settings file is unchanged; its saved values will return after restart.
settings.reset_session_only_no_file: Reset is active only in this session; no settings file was created. Defaults will be used on the next launch unless saving succeeds.
settings.reset_session_only_load_issue: Reset is active only in this session and was not saved. The settings file on disk is unchanged by this reset and will be read again on restart. User data that could not be loaded at startup cannot be recovered by this reset.
settings.reset_restart_note: Single-instance mode is read at launch and requires a restart to change.
